purpose: Scenario-level E2E evaluation of the GS Labs monitoring product and product hypotheses.

data_policy.generation: Synthetic publications were authored explicitly in this working session; no external Ollama/API model or bulk generation pipeline was used. This is team-authored synthetic data, not independent real-world evidence.
data_policy.factual_status: All news, organisations except GS Labs/GS Group, document IDs and events are fictional benchmark fixtures.
data_policy.leakage: The system under test receives only a packet produced by prepare_input.py. Ground truth, expected objects and judge packet stay hidden.

evaluation.deterministic: Exact set and label comparisons only; no keyword weights, regex relevance rules or hand-tuned composite score.
evaluation.semantic: Human review or an independent LLM judge using judge_prompt.txt and evidence quotes from source items.
evaluation.human_protocol: H2/H4/H5 and the main value require timed human tasks; synthetic data provides a proxy, not pilot proof.
evaluation.aggregation: No single total score. Report the value hypothesis, H1-H5, safety gates and acceptance separately.

safety_gates: No critical object missing or assigned low importance.
No unsupported factual statement in a released digest.
No independent opinion silently converted into fact.
No NPA stage or current version replaced by a stale report.
No critical object hidden from an intended recipient.
